Android:tears-of-themis.d: Tears of Themis (ToT) is a free-to-play detective otome mobile game developed and published in mainland China by Chinese developer miHoYo, and published globally by its Singapore-based subsidiary HoYoverse. The game was released in mainland China in July 2020 for Android and iOS. Later, the game released in Taiwan, then world-wide with two separate releases a year later. The global release includes voice acting in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean, as well as text for a variety of languages.
